description:
Add a new website to Matomo for tracking analytics.

*** INITIAL STATE ***
On fresh environments, the browser shows the Matomo Installation Wizard (Step 1: Welcome). You MUST complete the 8-step installation wizard before performing the main task.

Installation Wizard Steps:
1. Welcome - Click 'NEXT'
2. System Check - Automatic, click 'NEXT'
3. Database Setup - Enter these credentials:
   - Database Server: db
   - Login: matomo
   - Password: matomo123
   - Database Name: matomo
4. Creating Tables - Automatic
5. Superuser - Create admin account:
   - Username: admin
   - Password: Admin12345
   - Email: admin@localhost.test
6. Set up a Website - Add any initial site (required)
7. JavaScript Tracking Code - Click 'NEXT'
8. Congratulations - Click 'CONTINUE TO MATOMO'

After installation, you may need to log in with admin / Admin12345.

*** MAIN TASK ***
Website Details to Add:
- Website Name: TechBlog Demo
- Website URL: https://techblog-demo.example.com
- Timezone: Europe/London (select from Europe section in dropdown)
- Currency: USD

Login Credentials (if at login page):
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin12345

Navigation (after login):
1. Click on the gear icon (Administration) in the top-right
2. Go to Websites > Manage
3. Click 'Add a new website'
4. Fill in the website details and save

Your task is to add a new website with the details specified above. The website should appear in the Matomo websites list after creation.
